subject: Private offer setup — Corelli Health pricing and channel margin carveout
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@corellihealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@corellihealth.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Introduction — Corelli Health private offer & channel handling

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the intro from your team at Redwood. Corelli Health is evaluating an LLM inference provider for a regulated imaging product line. We'd like to explore a private offer on AWS Marketplace (and optionally GCP later) but have a couple of specific channel/commission constraints we need to accommodate for our reseller partners.

Short list:
- We invoice via AWS Marketplace (Corelli pays the AWS invoice) and then settle reseller commissions separately.
- We need the ability to set different reseller commission rates by SKU (hosted API vs dedicated/private deployment).
- Our procurement team will need a clear example waterfall that shows netback to Corelli under a few commit scenarios.

Could you share a sample pricing workbook and confirm whether Redwood can implement per-SKU reseller splits within a private offer? Also available for a 30-minute call next week (Jun 3–5); prefer morning PT.

Attached: procurement checklist (attached by procurement@corellihealth.com)

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Corelli Health
M: +1 415-555-0198
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@corellihealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Introduction — Corelli Health private offer & channel handling

Marta — great to meet you over email, thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a private offer on AWS with the behaviors you described; there are a few ways to structure the channel pass-through depending on whether you want the reseller to be paid by AWS settlement or via a separate Redwood-managed reconciliation.

High level proposal:
- Create separate SKUs in the private offer for Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved capacity), and On-Prem (if needed).
- Establish per-SKU reseller split tables (we can set different % netbacks by SKU).
- Two settlement models we typically use:
  1) AWS invoice to Corelli, Redwood pays reseller commission on net monthly settlement (Redwood-managed pass-through).
  2) AWS invoice to Corelli, reseller invoiced separately by Corelli / reseller (Corelli-managed).

If you can share target effective prices or commit level (ARR / annual token volume), Ben and I will run two scenarios and return a lightweight workbook. I can do Thu Jun 4 at 11:00 AM PT for a 30-minute call — does that work?

I'll attach a baseline pricing workbook and Ben will add a channel waterfall example.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0123
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@corellihealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Introduction — Corelli Health private offer & channel handling

Connor / Marta — adding the channel ops perspective.

Quick notes and an example:
- We've attached a simple waterfall workbook (channel-waterfall-corelli.xlsx) with two scenarios: an AWS-invoice-with-Redwood-settlement flow, and an AWS-invoice-with-Corelli-settlement flow. Numbers are illustrative but show how a 15% reseller gross margin would map to Corelli net across three commit tiers.
- Per-SKU splits: technically straightforward. We recommend defining the per-SKU % at offer creation; if you want to change it later there's a short change control window.
- Tax & invoicing: if Corelli wants the reseller commission outside of the AWS invoice, we will provide monthly CSVs for reconciliation and can support a remittance netting method.

Ask: can you confirm whether the reseller will be billing Corelli directly or whether Corelli wants Redwood to remit the commission to the reseller? That determines SOW wording and accounting cadence.

Attaching: channel-waterfall-corelli.xlsx (sample), pricing-scenarios-corelli.xlsx (baseline scenarios).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@corellihealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@corellihealth.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Introduction — Corelli Health private offer & channel handling

On Wed, Jun 3, 2026 at 11:20 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

> Connor / Marta — adding the channel ops perspective.
> 
> Quick notes and an example: ...

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement:
- Corelli will pay the AWS invoice. Reseller commissions are handled as a separate settlement (reseller invoices Corelli monthly). We will need Redwood's CSV to automate that process.
- We do want different reseller splits by SKU: Hosted API = 12% reseller commission; Dedicated (reserved) = 18% reseller commission; On-prem = 10% reseller commission.
- Final ask: can Redwood produce a signed appendix template that captures the per-SKU splits and the reconciliation CSV fields? Procurement attached our checklist (Corelli_procurement_checklist.pdf) with fields we need for legal & infosec.

If you can turn the two scenarios into a short, side-by-side workbook showing Corelli net under our proposed splits and a one-page appendix template, we're happy to take it to legal. We'd like a PO ready by Jun 18 if the numbers line up.

Best regards,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Corelli Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Introduction — Corelli Health private offer & channel handling

Ben / Hannah — quick internal plan based on Marta's reply:

Action items:
- Ben: revise the two scenario workbooks to reflect Corelli's requested per-SKU splits (Hosted 12%, Dedicated 18%, On-prem 10%) and export the reconciliation CSV spec. Deliver by EOD Fri Jun 5.
- Hannah: prep a short demo of dedicated vs hosted latency/cbilling for Jun 9 (ops stakeholders).
- Connor: produce a one-page appendix template for per-SKU splits and legal sign-off; include a DocuSign-ready version.

Tentative call with Corelli Thu Jun 4 11:00 AM PT — I'll send the calendar invite and a short agenda.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
